newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INVESTORS GRAB BARCO SHARES ON '96 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: INVESTORS GRAB BARCO SHARES ON '96 PROFIT.

text.p: Shares in Belgian electronics group Barco jumped over five percent on Thursday as investors bought Barco shares expecting the company to give them a good return.

Dealers said investors were picking up the stock after Barco announced a 31 percent hike in 1996 net current profit to 2.80 billion Belgian francs and forecast a further gain of at least 15 percent in 1997.
By 1020 GMT the share was up 4.45 percent at 5,870, after earlier touching 5,920 francs with a 160 million francs volume traded.
